title: Perfect reconstruction over infinitesimal inverse systems of rings
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $(A_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse sequence of commutative rings with surjective homomorphisms $A_{n+1}\to A_n$ whose kernels are locally nilpotent: every element of each kernel is nilpotent. Let $A=\varprojlim_n A_n$, the ring of compatible tuples. Use unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and derived extension and restriction of scalars [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Suppose $C_n\in D(A_n)$ is perfect for every $n$, meaning isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $A_n$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Suppose given maps $t_n:C_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}C_n$ in $D(A_{n+1})$ whose scalar-extension adjuncts $C_{n+1}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_{n+1}}A_n\to C_n$ are isomorphisms. Form $C=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_{A\to A_n}C_n$ in $D(A)$, using the homotopy inverse limit of [def-weil-derived-limit]. Then $C$ is perfect over $A$ and for every $n$ the projection-induced scalar-extension adjunct $C\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A_n\to C_n$ is an isomorphism in $D(A_n)$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-nil-ring-perfect-derived-limit] with $T_n=C_n$, with the given ring tower and transition maps, and with $T=C$. Its hypotheses are exactly available: all transition maps are surjective with elementwise nilpotent kernels, all $C_n$ are perfect over $A_n$, and the adjuncts of $t_n$ are isomorphisms. Both limits are formed in $D(A)$ after scalar restriction, using the same homotopy inverse limit and its projections. The cited statement gives that $C$ is perfect over $A$ and that the scalar-extension adjunct of each projection $C\to C_n$ is an isomorphism. Its map $\rho_n$ is therefore exactly the comparison requested here, rather than an unspecified isomorphism of objects. The additional naturality and transition-compatibility conclusions of the cited statement are not needed.
